# dsh-rick
English | 中文
C-137 skin for DeepSeek Harness: 28 catalog posters, user-added scenes, neon chrome, and overlay pet
s (Rick, Morty, portal gun).
Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2). 0.1.x and earlier used the pre-0.2.0 s
ettings model, which this plugin no longer targets.
Installable with `dsh plugin add` (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`). Listed format follows awesome-dsh-p
lable with `dsh plugin add` (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`). Listed format follows awesome-dsh-plugin.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then Settings → General → Skin. Default has no Remove control; every poster and custom card does. Pi
ck a poster to turn C-137 on (pins dark without changing Appearance). Click Rick for catchphrases; *
*Portal gun** draws the gun, the next Rick click fires the portal. Drag Rick or Morty onto the porta
l to pocket them. With both inside, click to summon Rick, click again for Morty, then click to shrin
k the portal closed.
Do not install this plugin on a DeepSeek Harness build that already vendors C-137 inside `@deepseek-
ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`. Two Skin rows would appear and both would write `data-dsh-skin`.

## What it adds

- Skin row after Appearance: Default, custom scenes (max 12), catalog `01`–`28`, Add image
- Durable
`c137` settings section: the Loader row id IS the namespace (`id: c137` in `cordis.patch.yml`), dec
laring `skin`, `skinBackground`, `skinBgOpacity`, `customScenes`, and `hiddenCatalog` as one volatil

e `Config` schema, so a skin change commits into the running config without remounting the plugin
-

Overlay pets on `shell.overlay` while the skin is `c137` (cap 4)
- C-137's palette registered as a u
i-theme alias-token layer via `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`, held only while the skin is on; the surfac

es go translucent there so the `body::before` poster layer reads through the chrome
- Host route `/d
sh-c137/*` for posters, pet frames, and `c137.css`
Does not change `agent-loop` or the session log. Catchphrases stay English in every locale.
### How the skin paints

This plugin draws none of the application chrome, so its visual half is entirely
document-level: the

`body[data-dsh-skin='c137']` attributes the static stylesheet
keys off, plus the alias-token layer.

The token layer is the only mechanism that can win. ui-theme's presenter projects
the active tokens

as **inline** styles on `body`, so a stylesheet rule that
redefines a `--dsw-*` token is silently ou

tranked; registering a layer folds the
values into the active definition instead, so the presenter w

rites ours. The
presenter also owns `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` and the root `color-scheme`,
deriving

both from the Appearance preference, so a skin that pins dark re-asserts
them through a `MutationOb
server` rather than changing that preference.

Structure is the part that cannot be re-targeted: 0.2.0 renders the frame and
sidebar with hashed CS

S-module classes and exposes no stable attribute for them,
so the column-level rules this skin once

used (`[data-app-frame]`,
`[data-app-sidebar]`, `[data-message-bubble]`, …) no longer match anything

. Their
surfaces come from tokens instead. `[data-composer-seat]` and
`[data-composer-card]` are the
two stable chrome hooks the stylesheet still uses.
